LESSON: INTEGRATED FARMING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.3: Integrated Farming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Integrated Farming. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can integrated farming conserve resources?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources
   In simple words: practise until you can describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Integrated Farming using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Integrated Farming in the examples.
2. Explain Integrated Farming to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Integrated Farming.
4. Show that you can: describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Integrated Farming using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Integrated Farming important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Creativity and Imagination: observation and making connection skills as learners seek information, design and make a model to depict an integrated farming enterprise.
2. Unity: teamwork as learners harness gifts and special skills of the group members in designing and making an integrated farming model.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
